messages:
Maria: Flagging the console toast that says "Too many requests. Try again later." Feels terse and a bit blaming. Can we make it clearer and accessible?

Alex: Yep. If backend returns Retry-After we should show it. Even an estimate like "~30 seconds" helps.

Jamal: Copy candidates:
1) "You're sending requests too quickly. Please wait 30 seconds and try again." 
2) "Rate limit reached — requests paused for 30 seconds. View request usage"
3) "Service busy — processing will resume shortly. Try again in ~30s."
Which tone? Calm, non-technical.

Maria: Leaning to 1 or 3. 2 is fine only if we add a non-intrusive link.

Rui: A11y checklist: role="status" + aria-live="polite"; spell out "seconds"; if button disabled use aria-disabled and announce countdown.

Jamal: UX notes: toast should be dismissible with Esc, not steal focus. Add a small "Try now" button disabled until ETA expires and show "(available in 12s)" so screen readers pick it up.

Alex: Backend: show exact Retry-After when present. Otherwise fallback to estimates: 15/30/60s based on recent retries.

Maria: Final engineering copy proposals:
- Short: "Rate limit reached — try again in {seconds} seconds."
- With CTA: "Rate limit reached — requests paused for {seconds} seconds. View request usage"
- Server-signal: "Service busy — we'll resume processing as capacity returns. Try again in {seconds} seconds."

design-bot: Action: add Figma frame with variants + disabled/active button states and aria attrs. Post to #eng-frontend with header "rate-limit toast copy + a11y".

Maria: I'll drop the Figma link here by EOD. Alex will open a PR to read Retry-After and wire the ETA logic.

Alex: Sounds good. For server-side congestion prefer the "Service busy" phrasing to avoid blaming users.
